Name: Beams Color Change
Author: tikamin557
Description:
You can change the color of beams, columns, and other parts of the house.
Currently there are 25 different colors to choose from!

The "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]" allows you to set the colors, parts to be applied, and locations.

The colors you can choose from are...
[quote]Black, White, Grey, Red, Orange, Vanilla, StrawYellow, CoffeeBrown, DarkerBrown, Cream, Yellow, Gold, LimeGreen, Green, Spruce, BabyBlue, SkyBlue, JojaBlue, Cyan, Blue, Violet, RoyalPurple, Purple, NeonPink, SAKURA, BabyPink[/quote][color=#00ffff][size=3]Color swatches are included in the mod folder.
[/size][/color]
[color=#ffff00]Some recolor mods are set to override the settings, so they can be used at the same time.
If you are using a recolor mod and the color changes do not apply when using this mod at the same time, please go to the POSTS page so we can add compatibility.[/color]

Currently available in English and Japanese.
